newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: U.S., Philippines call off military exercises.
newsitem.headline: U.S., Philippines call off military exercises.

text.p: The Philippines and the United States have agreed to cancel joint military exercises scheduled for this year, Philippine armed forces chief General Arnulfo Acedera said on Tuesday.
Acedera told a congressional hearing the Manila government needed time to review its policy concerning foreign soldiers involved in crime while in Philippine territory.
One of the issues under study was the extent of jurisdiction of the host country over a foreign soldier who commits a criminal offence while on or off duty, military sources said.

The sources said Manila had advised other countries that had agreed to conduct joint military exercises or training with the Philippines that it was putting such activities on hold until it had clarified the criminal jurisdiction issue.
These countries included Singapore, Malaysia and Britain, the sources said.
The first of two exercises planned with U.S. forces this year was to have been held this month, Acedera said.
